brief:
Israel has demolished homes across Hebron, Gaza, and southern Lebanon, according to Al Jazeera English, uprooting families and eliminating prospects for their return. The demolitions span multiple conflict zones in the occupied Palestinian territories and neighboring Lebanon.

The destruction targets residential structures across geographically dispersed areas, affecting Palestinian communities and Lebanese civilians. Families displaced by the demolitions face uncertain futures with limited pathways to rebuild their lives or reclaim their former homes.
dek: From Hebron to Gaza to southern Lebanon, Israel is tearing down homes, and, with them, families' hopes of return.
title: Israel demolishes homes across Hebron, Gaza, and southern Lebanon
